verdict.rationale: The evidence supports parts of the story only. A hands-on user describes working in Mailchimp's drag-and-drop builder, including a Code module (comm-16), and the pricing page lists custom-coded email templates (docs-37), backed by a generic 'Design better emails' claim (docs-14). On rendering, the only item is a help note on Gmail clipping emails over 102KB (docs-26). missing for 10: any evidence of personalization tokens or merge tags, documentation of reusable or saved template libraries and brand controls, evidence of rendering tests or previews across email clients, and in-depth editor docs.
